title: Class 12 through NIOS or distance education? Telangana Bar Council may not enrol you as an advocate
description: In late 2025, the Bar Council of Telangana (BCT) enrolled 4 law graduates whose applications had been pending for months - all of them distance or open university graduates. What set them apart from roughly 80 others in the same position who remain unenrolled is that they went to court. When Bar & Bench asked BCT Vice Chairman Sunil Goud why enrolment applications were being withheld, he said, "Those who are going to court will get relief but our hands are tied."What BCT saysIn a written res
